  "body": "# Conventions and Patterns\n\npi-packages is a monorepo containing approximately 21 TypeScript packages that extend pi-coding-agent. Each package exports zero or more extensions (runtime hooks into Pi) and/or skills (UI command surface). The canonical repository is badlogic/pi-mono.\n\n## Testing Approach\n\nThe project uses **Node.js built-in `node:test` framework** (stable since Node 20) for all testing, avoiding external dependencies like Jest or Mocha. Test files live in `tests/`, `tests/integration/`, and `tests/e2e/` directories with `.test.ts` or `.test.mjs` suffix. Tests run via `node --test \"tests/**/*.test.ts\"` — Node 22.18+ supports native TypeScript, eliminating the need for tsx.\n\n**Run commands:**\n```bash\nnpm run test                # unit + integration\nnpm run test:integration    # integration only\nnpm run test:e2e           # end-to-end (requires PI_PLUGINS_E2E_REF env var)\nnpm run test:coverage      # generates lcov reports\nnode --test \"tests/**/*.test.ts\"  # direct invocation (or with tsx on Node <22.18)\n```\n\nRecent commits demonstrate the testing philosophy: comprehensive verification that **tests actual behavior, not pre-existing state**. Commit 7e270a7 (September 22, 2026) fixed terminal tests that \"had been passing on pre-existing screen state without asserting on the actual startup state.\" The new tests verify the complete terminal experience from startup through multiline input.\n\nPackage-local `npm run check` runs strict TypeScript plus `node:test` through `tsx`, eliminating machine-specific dependencies. Lifecycle tests drive the real Pi SDK and pi-delegate extension against a scripted loopback HTTP provider, verifying reload, fork, wait/cancel/revival, wake-up delivery, ownership, cold inspection, and SIGKILL recovery **without credentials or model API calls**. Tests have reproduced real defects including provider errors surfacing as successful completion and missing providers in child's model runtime (commit f846e8a).\n\nCustom text/JSON renderers for child transcripts were replaced with **Pi's native message, tool, and editor components**, providing collapsed tool results, native formatting, newest-output follow with paged scrollback, and fullscreen mouse support.
